All values are **approximate** and given in **CGS** unless noted.

## Fundamental Constants (CGS)

| Constant | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $G$ | $6.67\times 10^{-8}$ | cm$^3$ g$^{-1}$ s$^{-2}$ |
| $c$ | $3.00\times 10^{10}$ | cm/s |
| $h$ | $6.63\times 10^{-27}$ | erg s |
| $\hbar$ | $1.05\times 10^{-27}$ | erg s |
| $k_B$ | $1.38\times 10^{-16}$ | erg/K |
| $\sigma$ | $5.67\times 10^{-5}$ | erg s$^{-1}$ cm$^{-2}$ K$^{-4}$ |
| $m_p$ | $1.67\times 10^{-24}$ | g |
| $m_n$ | $1.68\times 10^{-24}$ | g |
| $m_e$ | $9.11\times 10^{-28}$ | g |
| $1\,\rm eV$ | $1.60\times 10^{-12}$ | erg |
| $e$ | $4.80\times 10^{-10}$ | statC (esu) |

## Solar & Planetary Reference Values (CGS)

| Quantity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| $M_\odot$ | $1.99\times 10^{33}$ g |
| $R_\odot$ | $6.96\times 10^{10}$ cm |
| $L_\odot$ | $3.84\times 10^{33}$ erg/s |
| $T_{\rm eff,\odot}$ | $5800$ K |
| $M_\oplus$ | $5.97\times 10^{27}$ g |
| $R_\oplus$ | $6.38\times 10^{8}$ cm |
| $M_J$ | $1.90\times 10^{30}$ g |
| $R_J$ | $7.14\times 10^{9}$ cm |

## Astronomical Distances & Time

| Quantity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| 1 AU | $1.50\times 10^{13}$ cm |
| 1 pc | $3.09\times 10^{18}$ cm |
| 1 ly | $9.46\times 10^{17}$ cm |
| 1 yr | $3.15\times 10^{7}$ s |

## Angle Conversions

| Quantity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| $1$ full circle | $360^{\circ} = 2\pi$ rad |
| $1^{\circ}$ | $60'$ (arcmin) |
| $1'$ | $60''$ (arcsec) |
| $1''$ | $4.85\times 10^{-6}$ rad |
